description: Continuation headline pairs (prev shipped -> current shipped) for the same story thread, labelled BLIND: each pair was read and labelled before any similarity score was computed, so the labels are not anchored to the metric they exist to test.

labels.null: curr states no development that prev did not already state -- the defect
labels.ok: curr states a genuine new development
labels.borderline: thin but arguably new; excluded from positives, reported separately

provenance: Derived from thread_installments (matched_score IS NOT NULL) joined to shown_narratives via cluster_id, runs 205-245. 3 pairs where the join produced unrelated stories are marked 'artifact' and excluded.
warning: Labelled by one rater (Claude) in one pass. Treat as a working set, not gold. Re-label disputed rows before trusting a headline number.
